name: Chime Pinring
description: Picture the spread of a burst before the throw and choose the landing point that sends splinters where wanted.

name: Lancing Cap
description: Weigh the shell on a level palm to learn its flaws and adjust the throw to match.

name: Rumblecasing
description: Sink the hips and release from a settled stance so the swing never shakes the aim.

name: Charter Powderchamber
description: Roll after release toward the side where splinters will not fly.

name: Granite Lever
description: Land the shell against a solid face so its burst spreads along that face and spares the open side.

name: Detonate Assault
description: Land the shell in open ground so its burst spreads in every direction and breaks a loose line.

name: Fuseassault
description: Shape the burst with qi so more of its splinters fly along the line the thrower chose.

name: Toxinspoon
description: Set a shell with a fused cord across a path so a passing foe tugs the cord and brings the burst.

name: Verity Shrapnel
description: Read tracks and bent grass at first light to learn where foes pass and where they pause.

name: Thorn Kaboom
description: Lash the shell to a peg with cord so it cannot be rolled aside before a foe steps close.

name: Soaring Spoon
description: Crawl on the elbows to the trap site with the shell held clear of the ground.

name: Gust Fragmentation
description: Step back along the same line one heel at a time so the setter leaves no fresh trace.

name: Furrowing Shockwave
description: Bury a shell under a loose board so a footstep sets off the burst beneath the foe.

name: Slag Firecap
description: Hang a shell above a doorway on a cord that drops when the door opens and bursts at head height.

name: Murksizzle
description: Drop a dud shell in plain sight to draw foes to cover just where a live shell lies.

name: Fastening Casing
description: Lay shells along a narrow path so the first burst drives foes forward onto the next in line.

name: Facet Fragment
description: Set shells around a yard so a foe running from one burst runs into another.

name: Ravaging Fuse
description: Let the qi field steady the shell a hand's breadth from the palm so the grip never tires.

name: Clear Powderchamber
description: Feel through the qi field where others stand in the dark so the throw finds them unseen.

name: Chimecap
description: Throw with the qi field laid along the path so the flight stays true in a crosswind.

name: Gust Fuse
description: Slip aside inside the qi field the instant a returning shell is felt.

name: Thornlever
description: Draw the field close about head and chest to soften the ring and the push of a near burst.

name: Nova Sizzle
description: Nudge the shell in flight with a pull of the field to bring a stray throw back onto the target.

name: Shrapnel Thrash
description: Press the qi field at the moment of burst so splinters fly in a narrower fan.

name: Casing Hauberk
description: Parry a lobbed shell with a sweep of the field so it flies back toward its thrower.

name: Siltspoon
description: Keep the qi field alive through a long run of throws so each shell goes out in quick order.

name: Thorncasing
description: Hold the field like a casing round a fallen friend as a burst lands beside them so splinters fall short.

name: Discerning Pinring
description: Toss a pinch of ash and watch where it drifts to decide where the smoke will lie.

name: Might Shockwave
description: Crawl beneath the rising smoke where the air is clear and the foe sees nothing.

name: Gustcap
description: Close the eyes against the flash and throw by the count alone toward a memorised mark.

name: Unyielding Spoon
description: Tie a damp cloth over mouth and nose before entering a field thick with powder smoke.

name: Caplinctus
description: Watch the spark trail of the fuse to guess how far splinters will carry across the ground.

name: Might Detonate
description: Move along the edge of a smoke bank to reach the foe's side before the air clears.

name: Glamour Firecap
description: Throw shells in a row along the foe's front so their grey puffs join into one bank.

name: Ravaging Cap
description: Throw so the shell lies close against a bank of earth and its splinters spray only forward.

name: Splintering Sizzle
description: Throw back into the smoke toward the flash of an enemy shell before the smoke has cleared.

name: Mayhem Lever
description: Lay a heavy cloud of burst smoke over a narrow pass so foes cough and stumble as they cross.

name: Charter Fragment
description: Keep a steady fall of shells on one patch of ground so no foe dares cross it.

name: Granite Concussion
description: Draw one shell with each hand together so both tracks of the throw are ready at once.

name: Shrapnel Remedy
description: Count two fuses at once with one breath for each so both shells are tracked together.

name: Lancing Fragment
description: Release the left-hand shell and the right-hand shell a heartbeat apart toward two separate marks.

name: Facetcasing
description: Drop with a partner into back-to-back crouches so each covers the other's blind side.

name: Blaze Concussion
description: Throw two shells at two points a short space apart so the bursts meet in the middle.

name: Tearing Powderchamber
description: Swing the throw from one track to the other mid-motion so the foe guards the wrong line.

name: Careening Shockwave
description: One partner throws and the other rushes at the burst so the two tracks of attack arrive together.

name: Slagsizzle
description: Two grenadiers throw from opposite sides so their bursts cross over the foe and leave no clear side.

name: Mantled Lever
description: While one partner throws the other holds the qi open before both so splinters fall short.

name: Sharp Spoon
description: Fix the eyes on one point of the foe's line as a hawk fixes on a hare.

name: Glint Detonate
description: Raise the throwing arm slowly like a lifting wing so the foe's eye rises with it.

name: Facetspoon
description: Drop the arm suddenly in a stoop and release so the shell falls steeply onto the mark.

name: Glintsizzle
description: Pinch the shell between thumb and two fingers like a talon for a short quick lob.

name: Adamant Casing
description: Take cover on a height and lean out only to drop shells on those beneath.

name: Kaboom Onslaught
description: Circle a point on the move and throw once on each turn so bursts fall around it.

name: Gustkaboom
description: Dive low from a perch after the throw and glide away from the foe's return fire.

name: Glamour Fuse
description: Lob a shell short of hidden men so the burst flushes them into the open.

name: Downpour Fragmentation
description: Release a rapid string of lofts from a height so the shells fall in turn upon one point of the line.

name: Furrowing Fragmentation Barrage
description: Hold a position above a field and drop shells at intervals so no foe below dares move out.

name: Facetlever
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with a partner in a shared stance that covers both throwing arms.

name: Wary Cap
description: Use a fixed two-word signal between partners to name the target and the count.

name: Remnant Pinring
description: Match qi circulation with a partner so the two throw on one beat without looking at each other.

name: Torrent Concussion
description: Step forward in mirror with a partner so one side always covers the other's advance.

name: Glint Kaboom
description: Keep one shell ready in the off hand for a throw the instant the first one bursts.

name: Vaulting Shockwave
description: Partners swap places in the line after a throw so the rested arm takes the next one.

name: Granite Powderchamber
description: Partners throw in turn at one point so the burst never ends before the next begins.

name: Fusetorment
description: Two partners guide one shell together by joined field so it lands where neither could reach alone.

name: Hastening Sizzle
description: Withdraw in pairs through a lane of bursts that each partner lays behind the other.

name: Slag Casing
description: Chain bursts from two sides in a ring so the foe's ground is struck in a steady circle.

name: Nova Firecap
description: Partners lay shells in a paired pattern so any path through their ground meets two bursts.

name: Charter Spoon
description: Plant the feet on a sloped bank so the throw drives forward and the body does not slide.

name: Chime Concussion
description: Throw from the rim of a hollow so the shell drops into the basin among those below.

name: Waninglever
description: Watch the drift of floating debris to judge the current and guess where foes will cross.

name: Torrent Sizzle
description: Leap from stone to stone across a stream while carrying shells high and dry.

name: Blazecap
description: Place a shell where the stream shallows so the burst throws water and iron upon those crossing.

name: Blaze Lever
description: Cast shells into a hollow in a steady stream so every corner of the basin is struck in turn.

name: Deed Cap
description: Lay shells along the high-water line so a foe retreating from the river steps upon them.

name: Rupturing Pinring
description: Throw from a bend to rake a long reach of the river so no boat or ford can be used.
